title: Needed 1+1, built a functional programming language
summary: A developer created a custom functional programming language from scratch because they wanted a language where basic arithmetic like '1+1' returns 2 as expected. The project walks through building core language components including a lexer, parser, and evaluator for a simple functional language with proper mathematical behavior.
problem_solved: Addresses the frustration of programming languages where basic operations don't behave as mathematically expected.
why_valuable: Provides a practical, hands-on introduction to compiler/interpreter construction with a real-world motivation that resonates with developers.
